key.name: monkeytype-username
key.description: Your Monkeytype username to fetch typing activity data.

key.name: monkeytype-apekey
key.description: Your Monkeytype ApeKey for API authentication.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Time in seconds between refreshing Monkeytype typing activity data.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: The position of the extension indicator in the panel.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: The index position within the chosen panel section.

key.name: show-current-week-only
key.description: Whether to show only tests from the current week instead of the last 7 days.

key.name: week-start-day
key.description: The day of the week on which the week starts.

key.name: highlight-current-day
key.description: Adds a white border around the current day's box for easier identification.

key.name: theme-name
key.description: The color theme to use for displaying typing activity.

key.name: color-mode
key.description: Whether to use opacity-based or grade-based coloring for typing activity.

key.name: days-to-show
key.description: Number of days to display in the top bar (1-7).

key.name: right-click-action
key.description: What to open when right-clicking the extension (profile or homepage).

key.name: shortcut-refresh
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to refresh typing activity data.

key.name: shortcut-open-monkeytype
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open Monkeytype homepage or profile.

key.name: shortcut-open-profile
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open user profile on Monkeytype.
